_comment: HEADERS ONLY - deliberately no routing directives.
This site deploys on Vercel, so netlify.toml is inert: the security
headers it declares were never actually served. Vercel supplies HSTS on
its own; these are the rest.
No cleanUrls / trailingSlash here on purpose. The live URLs already
resolve correctly and those keys change routing, which is not worth
risking on a production site to gain nothing.
No Content-Security-Policy either: the pages load the LeadConnector chat
widget, Google Maps embeds and Google Fonts, and a CSP written without
testing would break one of them. Add one deliberately if you want it.
